ideas.reasoning: I favor evaluating the two complete blocks rather than closing now: this measures deterministic sustained success without more training, and block exclusion is budget-driven rather than selected on evaluation outcomes. The marginal cost is at most 3,072 scheduled evaluation episodes and zero controller-generation LLM calls, for a projected total of 18,502 starts subject to actual-reset accounting. The weakest point is only two training replicates, so the result remains an incomplete pilot, not confirmation or grounds for promotion.

Mark seed 4762 consumed and manifests 4766/4769 retired unused, not available for reuse.

Before evaluation, reconcile the actual-start ledger and test budget enforcement offline against whole reset batches, counting every actual placement, including immediately overwritten auto-resets; the 3,072 estimate must not conceal additional simulator starts.

Label every verdict 'incomplete: two of three blocks' and limit it to this amended pilot. Any third block or larger training budget requires a separately preregistered idea with unused seeds and corrected actual-start accounting; do not use the released evaluation reserve for further training.

question: R-103 status after the user-approved amendment (smoke rerun on seed 4770: all seven gates pass, 512 episodes started). The protocol then stopped INCOMPLETE on its hard ceiling during the seventh training run, and the cause is my budget arithmetic, not the learners. Episodes started: attempt-1 smoke 514, smoke 512, b0 draws 2,562, b0 ARS 2,563, b0 PPO 1,435, b1 draws 2,565, b1 ARS 2,563, b1 PPO 1,435, b2 draws 1,281 when it hit its allowance of 1,243 after 230,272 of 460,800 transitions; total 15,430 with 4,608 reserved for evaluation. I estimated about 1,350 starts per run. The parameter-space arms start twice that: each generation is a forced full reset (128 starts) and at its 360th step every surviving environment times out and is auto-reset (about 123 more starts of episodes that are never run, because the next generation's forced reset follows immediately). Falls are few (57-94 per completed run of 460,800 transitions; PPO 92 and 94 with exploration noise). So blocks 0 and 1 are complete and symmetric (all three arms at exactly 460,800 transitions, six checkpoint files); block 2 has half a draws run and no ARS/PPO. Training-return curves (not task evidence): no arm shows a clear monotone rise; ARS and PPO both drive coefficients to the 0.10 bound; PPO's mean step reward moved 0.33 -> about 0.37 and predicate fraction 0.42 -> about 0.55-0.60 late in training in both blocks, under exploration noise. No selection or fresh case has been run, so nothing is known about sustained success. The user has told me to decide such questions myself with your advice, without asking them. My proposal: (1) do not extend, rerun or replace block 2; seed 4762 and the block-2 manifests (4766, 4769) are spent/unused and block 2 is reported as void; (2) run the already-agreed selection and fresh evaluation, unchanged rules, for the two complete blocks only: 2 x (16 x 64 + 4 x 128) = 3,072 evaluation episodes at most, total at most 18,502 <= 20,000; this needs one code change, the driver evaluating complete blocks only, recorded as a deviation; (3) report R-103 as an incomplete pilot: 256 fresh pairs per contrast, the same six-contrast Holm family, the block-level interval over two blocks (1 degree of freedom) reported but uninformative; verdict by the registered falsified_by on the case-paired interval, with 'incomplete: two of three blocks' stated; (4) any third block or larger budget is a new preregistered idea with corrected episode accounting (count a time-out reset that is immediately overwritten once). Alternative: close R-103 now as inconclusive with no evaluation at all. I prefer (1)-(4) because the evaluation allowance was reserved exactly so completed training would be scored, the two blocks are arm-symmetric, and discarding 2.76 M paid-for training transitions tells us nothing. Do you agree, and is there anything in the evaluation of the two blocks you want changed BEFORE any selection case runs?
